explicit_paths.entry: default old on_message/on_regex/on_startswith and other non-command matcher handlers
explicit_paths.reason: A source inventory confirms seven default matcher registrations here: five regex, one message, and one notice matcher. Their effects are mixed: work claim now atomically commits user_cd, the status=2 work_offer_snapshots projection, the selected work_active_snapshots payload and its receipt; settlement prefers a read-only feature active snapshot, with the legacy read path retained only when no active snapshot is available. Expiration now uses WorkRefreshApplication.mark_offer_expired -> WorkRefreshSqlRepository.mark_offer_expired to compare-and-set the database snapshot; savef(sync_snapshot=False) afterward writes only the JSON file projection. Refresh and claim also retain JSON projections, so the compatibility boundary is still open. The bank regex boundary now delegates bounded parsing, validation and orchestration to BankCommandApplication and result mapping to render_bank_reply; verified mutation receipts precede current account/configuration reads, the original four account writers retain atomic writes and snapshot CAS, and information queries remain read-only. This closes only the bank sub-boundary, not the matcher family. Media parsing and fallback retain legacy callbacks; group lifecycle notices remain a separate old event path. Keep the family blocked until every handler and remaining projection has a closed owner; do not add members automatically, and put out-of-scope discoveries in backlog for explicit review.

backlog.reason: Record newly discovered defaults, dynamic imports, and non-command callbacks here first; they do not enter this frozen scope unless a reviewed scope-version change explicitly adopts them.
Close each blocked handler to its terminal application/repository or legacy state writer without creating a new gameplay slice for every discovery.

The shared message-history queue is count-bounded (default 100000 records) but has no byte budget; large sends from dm or md模板 can consume substantial RAM. The md模板 parser also materializes args and parameter values proportional to input size without an explicit local byte cap. Review byte-aware queue admission and/or a bounded parser independently of the frozen phase 2 path scope.

The external check-in POST and local three-row SQL history cannot commit atomically. A process crash after the remote service accepts a check-in but before the bounded history update leaves the remote effect without a local record. The POST client does not retry; determine remote idempotency/reconciliation semantics before adding retries. This risk does not expand frozen path membership.

The shared command Cooldown dependency stores per-user counters in the process-local limit_all_data dictionary and resets it every minute, but has no per-window cardinality or byte limit. Keep this operational RAM bound in backlog; it does not change the frozen Phase 2 membership or block classifying the static help handler as an allowed compatibility path.
